# Every name loopvec adds begins with an underscore, and some are declared before
# the loop or inside it, where they would shadow the function's own: a parameter
# named _w1 or _count, a limit named _i, or a local named like a broadcast vector
# would then refer to loopvec's variable, so a function that uses such a name is
# left alone; the blank identifier is not such a name. The code also relies on
# predeclared names (len, min, copy, uint64, ...) and on the packages simd and
# unsafe: a loop where one of them, looked up from the loop, is a local, a
# package-level declaration or an import of something else is left alone too,
# while a declaration the loop cannot see (max after it) does not matter. The
# scalar loop that finishes a reduction redeclares the loop's variables around
# its bound, so a loop variable must not take one of those names either, nor a
# name used by the range operand or the start of a loop that counts down
# (for n := range n, for n := n - 1; n >= 0; n--). The overlap helper loopvec
# declares in the package relies on a few more predeclared names (uintptr,
# ...), which the package must not redeclare. The rewritten package must build.

loopvec -json ./...
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

loopvec -split .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go build .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func WindowName(dst, _w1 []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = _w1[i] + 1
	}
}

func CountName(dst, a []int32, _count int) {
	for i := 0; i < len(dst); i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+_count] + 1
	}
}

func IndexName(dst, a []int32, _i int) {
	for i := 0; i < _i; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func BroadcastName(dst []float32, c float32) float32 {
	_vcFloat32s0 := c * 2
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] *= c
	}
	return _vcFloat32s0
}

func Blank(dst, a []int32, _ int) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func LocalLen(dst, a []int32) {
	len := func(s []int32) int { return 2 }
	_ = len
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}

func LocalMin(dst, a []int32, k int) {
	min := func(x, y int) int { return 0 }
	_ = min
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i+k] + 1
	}
}

func MaxAfterLoop(dst, a []int32) int32 {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
	max := int32(0)
	for _, v := range dst {
		if v > max {
			max = v
		}
	}
	return max
}
func SumCount(a []int32, n int) int32 {
	var s int32
	for n := range n {
		s += a[n]
	}
	return s
}

func SumIndexLen(a []int32) int32 {
	var s int32
	for len := range a {
		s += a[len]
	}
	return s
}

func SumDown(a []int32, n int) int32 {
	var s int32
	for n := n - 1; n >= 0; n-- {
		s += a[n]
	}
	return s
}

func SumByte(a []byte) byte {
	var s byte
	{
		type byte = int8
		var _ byte
		for _, x := range a {
			s += x
		}
	}
	return s
}
-- pkglen/ops.go --
package pkglen

func len(s []int32) int { return cap(s) / 4 }

func Double(dst, a []int32, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i] * 2
	}
}
-- pkguintptr/ops.go --
package pkguintptr

type uintptr = int32

func Inc(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + 1
	}
}
-- alias/ops.go --
package alias

import simd "strings"

var _ = simd.ToUpper

func Double(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] * 2
	}
}
